title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Nine independent remote title passes against Built In's current rendered job pages. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 22, 2026 — all nine remote title passes completed via direct fetch (no browser needed). 3 new eligible postings auto-filed at score 6-7 (Banyan Software, Estoras Group, Sureify). Also fixed a schema gap from the prior run: previously-excluded ineligible/hard-gated postings (Hadrian, Sparksoft x2, Rain, Cardinal Health) are now proper scored rows instead of notes-only prose, per reports/report_schema.md.

rows.title: FDE Infrastructure SRE Engineer - Canada

rows.title: Senior SRE (Modernized Application Operations)

notes_sections.heading: September 22 pass audit
items: Complete remote passes: Site Reliability Engineer, Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer (3 results, all previously known), Azure DevOps Engineer (zero results), and Forward Deployed Engineer. All 9 passes used direct WebFetch against builtin.com/jobs/remote/dev-ops?search=<term> — no browser needed this run, and no CAPTCHA/block encountered.

Geography/city passes (Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall, Montréal hybrid; plus the Canada-hub remote-discovery cities) were not run this session — the prior run (2026-09-21) documented that Built In's location filter does not reliably change rendered results, and this run's time budget went to fully validating the 9 role-query passes instead, including fixing the prior run's notes-only-exclusion schema gap. Geography passes remain the standing incomplete boundary for this source.
Inviso Corporation's original FDE Infrastructure SRE Engineer posting resurfaced again (already Applied 2026-09-19) — retained as a pipeline match, not rescored.

notes_sections.heading: Schema fix this run
items: The prior run (2026-09-21) put Hadrian, both Sparksoft postings, Rain, and Cardinal Health in notes-only prose ("Ineligible"/"Hard-gated" bullet lists) instead of scored table rows, which contradicts reports/report_schema.md's explicit instruction that every ruled-out posting is a row (score 0 or -1), never a footer/notes list. Converted all five to proper rows this run; no new information, same exclusion reasons.

notes_sections.heading: Not opened this run — volume boundary
items: Forward Deployed Engineer query (25 results): beyond the 3 opened in full (Coveo, Lyric, Docebo — all out of scope, confirming the historical pattern that this keyword mostly surfaces customer-facing AI/software-implementation roles), the remaining 22 were screened by title/company only and not opened: Webflow, Sardine, Spellbook, Magical, TAR, NegotiateAI, SecurityScorecard, SensorUp, CruxOCM, GC AI, S32, Tiger Analytics, Nexaminds, AI Fund, Retell AI (x2, one explicitly "New Grad"), Tines ("West" — US region), H Company (explicitly US), Cohere AI's public-sector FDE variant (likely clearance-gated), CoLab Software (mechanical FDE, wrong domain), Caylent (x2, already Applied/tracked).

Reliability Engineer query: Jumpstart Refugee Talent, SCR-Sibelco graduate programme, Cerebras kernel reliability, nesto "Senior Data Reliability Developer" (QA-flavored), MrBeast quality/reliability, and Tailscale's "Customer Reliability Engineer" (a stale/mismatched permalink pointing to a Tier-3 support role) were screened by title only — none read as core infrastructure/DevOps.

Platform Engineer query: several Block/Cash App/Affirm/Kraken/Speechify/WEX/GitLab listings are core product/backend software-engineering roles (iOS, Ruby, data platform, agentic SDLC) screened out by title; Kinaxis "Machine Learning/Operations Research Platform Engineer" and Vena Solutions "Site Reliability Developer 1" are plausible-but-not-yet-opened — worth a follow-up pass.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Direct HTTP retrieval via WebFetch worked cleanly for every search page and every job detail page attempted (aside from the two slug-collision cases in Could not validate) — no browser needed this run.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, sign-in, or write-side action occurred on builtin.com.

method: Nine role-query passes (Site Reliability Engineer, Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer) against Built In's remote/dev-ops search, all fetched directly without a browser. Geography/city passes were not run this session — Built In's location filter has not reliably worked across the last several runs; that remains the standing incomplete boundary. 22 new postings were opened and fully validated this run; the remainder of a much larger raw result set was screened by title only where the domain mismatch was unambiguous (customer-facing FDE implementation roles, core product/backend software engineering, new-grad internships).
